# Lab 13.4: AI.IF: Semantic Filtering & Joins

## What We Are Going to Do
Filter rows with a natural-language condition, combine it with normal filters, and join two tables by meaning.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] Semantic filter.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT title, body
FROM `bigquery-public-data.bbc_news.fulltext`
WHERE category = 'business'
  AND AI.IF(('This news story is about a company merger or takeover: ', body))
LIMIT 10;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   The cheap filter `category = 'business'` runs first, so fewer rows are sent to Gemini.

3. **[SQL] Semantic join.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE lab13.topics AS
SELECT * FROM UNNEST(['climate and environment', 'mobile phones', 'football transfers']) AS topic;

SELECT t.topic, n.title
FROM lab13.topics t
JOIN (SELECT title, body FROM `bigquery-public-data.bbc_news.fulltext` LIMIT 200) n
  ON AI.IF(('This article: ', n.body, ' is mainly about: ', t.topic))
ORDER BY t.topic;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **[SQL] Add examples for a subjective condition.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL

<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT title FROM lab13.reviews
WHERE AI.IF(
  ('This review is very emotional: ', review),
  examples =&gt; [('I cried through the whole ending, it broke my heart', TRUE),
               ('The film is 2 hours long and in colour', FALSE)]
);</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| `AI.IF` | Returns TRUE / FALSE per row |
| Filter order | Normal filters run first |
| Semantic join | Matches by meaning, not by key |
| `examples` | Teach the model a subjective rule |
